versions.name: Distillation Column
versions.summary: Bring a binary column from cold start to steady state, tuning reflux ratio against overhead purity under realistic lag.
versions.description: Learners start a binary column from cold and bring it to steady state. They then change the reflux ratio and watch the overhead purity respond with realistic lag. Lowering the reflux ratio raises the overhead purity, at the cost of more reboiler heat.

delivery.browserAndComputer: Laptop or desktop with a current web browser

delivery.deviceNeeded: Standalone VR headset and about 2 × 2 m of clear floor
delivery.installNotes: Install the build named above and open “Column Lab”.
